$comment: Private-target allowlist for scripts/link-check (issue #149). External URLs are never fetched by the gate (walled/anti-bot surfaces answer 403 to bots, #132), so a private family repo needs an explicit declaration, not a resolution. `target` must be an http(s) URL (validated). Each entry records WHY the target is private and the TRIGGER that removes it; a declared target nothing in scope references is reported as W-ALLOWLIST-UNUSED so the registry cannot rot silently. This file is data, not a manifest: Dependabot does not read it. Empty since #273: the entry for `profile-data-template` left by its own removalTrigger (not by that warning) when the repo went public — verified 2026-10-23, `gh repo view ChristianLuciani/profile-data-template --json visibility` -> PUBLIC, HTTP 200 — so every on-ramp A link now resolves.
